title: Doctor Shortage Affects Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hospitals
excerpt: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa faces a severe doctor shortage, with only 8,024 physicians available for a population exceeding 40 million.
body_html:
Hospitals in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are currently facing a significant shortage of medical professionals. According to recent data, the region has a total of 8,024 doctors to serve a population of more than 40 million residents.

This disparity results in a high ratio of patients to each available physician across the area, highlighting the strain on local healthcare facilities and services.
